llm.summary: This skill is a clearly documented self-hosted speech service integration, with real but disclosed risks around sending audio/text to the configured server and storing staged files there.

dimensions.detail: Outbound HTTP, optional bearer tokens, server-side URL fetching, and model downloads are proportionate for speech processing, with explicit warnings about trusted endpoints, HTTPS, auth, SSRF blocking, and debug logging.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Setup uses Docker images, curl, ffmpeg, local data mounts, and optional GPU access; these are purpose-aligned and documented, but users should review the image source and bind/exposure settings.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions repeatedly scope operations to the configured TALKIES_URL, disclose that data leaves the host, and warn agents not to browse or delete other callers' staged files.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Staged uploads, cached URL downloads, model data, and custom voice samples persist server-side and the staging bucket has no per-caller isolation, but the artifact clearly discloses this and gives cleanup and access-control guidance.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The network calls, ASR/TTS requests, voice-cloning examples, MCP tools, and file-staging behavior match the stated purpose of operating a self-hosted OpenAI-compatible speech service.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you trust the Talkies server or operate it yourself. Prefer localhost or HTTPS with TALKIES_AUTH_TOKEN, avoid sending confidential text/audio or unauthorized voice samples, enable private-download blocking on exposed servers, do not run debug logging with real data, and clean up staged files and custom voices after use.
llm.findings: [E1] expected: The flagged speech and voice-cloning examples transmit user-provided text and selected voice material to TALKIES_URL; this is core functionality, openly documented, and accompanied by warnings to use trusted, authenticated servers and consented voice samples.
